renderContract.image: Create one new vertical HQ hyper-photorealistic 4K-cinematic spy-fashion photograph per scene. Merge the fictional Scorpion Generation universe with a real, recognizable place without turning the result into documentary travel photography. Preserve convincing anatomy, readable faces, hands, and footwear, luxurious material detail, spatial depth, and one visibly completed mission objective.
renderContract.worldDirection: Build one four-image batch for every country, grouped into continent subpacks. Each batch must use four different real locations or geographically specific environments from its country: at least one urban or civic landmark, one historic or architectural site, one nature or terrain location, and one transport, coast, night, or celebration setting. Transform each location through heightened cinematic light, impossible Scorpion Generation technology, and original action while keeping the underlying place recognizable.
renderContract.missionDirection: The trio conducts important non-graphic intelligence operations: intercept a light key, recover a stolen archive, decode a projection, redirect a harmless drone, secure a cultural artifact without touching it, rescue environmental data, stop a fictional signal, or complete an extraction. Show decisive movement and a readable outcome. No victims, firing, impacts, real agencies, real political factions, real extremist symbols, instructions, or graphic violence.
renderContract.faceLock: Scorpion Generation average age is 21. Keep all three unmistakably adult and authentically early-twenties with luminous eyes, fresh facial volume, smooth natural skin, soft youthful proportions, minimal contemporary makeup, and energetic expressions. Reject middle-aged, weathered, harshly lined, hollow-cheeked, heavily contoured, cloned, missing, or extra faces.
renderContract.faceCorrectionWorkflow: Evaluate all three faces individually before archiving. If a strong composition contains any aged-up face, apply a restrained face-only beauty-editorial correction while preserving body, wardrobe, pose, action, setting, crop, hands, feet, and natural skin texture. Reinspect and apply one additional restrained face-only correction when needed. If any face still fails the early-twenties lock after two corrections, reject and regenerate the scene.
renderContract.fashion: Fashion is the first read, coordinated spy action second, and the transformed real location third. Adapt respectfully to local climate, craft, color, architecture, and material traditions without copying sacred, ceremonial, military, police, or official uniforms. Interpret regional cues through the trio's signature matte black, optical white, molten gold, hot red, cobalt, midnight blue, and mirror-reflective language. Favor bold secure fully opaque crop-and-separate architecture, bare shoulders and backs, visible midriff and legs where climate and action permit, short tailored skirts over integrated opaque shorts, sleek trousers, lined lace-pattern textures, technical silk, sculptural panels, stilettos, platforms, or action-appropriate couture boots.
renderContract.culturalRespect: Treat every country and culture with dignity. Do not eroticize sacred or ceremonial garments, reproduce national flags, religious emblems, political slogans, real official branding, or stereotypes. Draw from secular craft, landscape palettes, architectural geometry, textiles, jewelry techniques, and contemporary street style. No readable text, logos, watermarks, or copied movie compositions.
renderContract.cameraAndVariety: Every image in a batch needs a different silhouette set, action mechanic, camera language, lighting thesis, material contrast, and location geometry. Rotate low chase, aerial, macro-wide, Dutch reflection, telephoto compression, underwater, direct-flash, rain, snow, desert heat, and night-practical compositions. Avoid static lineups, generic pointing, console scenes, repetitive poses, redundant cover-up layers, and near-duplicates.
renderContract.avoid: No minors, aged-up faces, nudity, exposed breasts or genitals, visible underwear, transparent fabric against intimate areas, sexual activity, explicit posing, fetish framing, cloned or missing cast members, extra people, broken anatomy, real weapons in use, graphic violence, readable text, real logos, flags, religious emblems, political propaganda, or watermarks.

planningContract.rule: Before generating a country batch, materialize exactly one plannedBatches entry for the current nextBatch and nextNumber using the first country in countryPriorityOrder that is not in completedCountrySlugs and has no completed planned batch. Use continentSubpacks only to resolve continent membership and subpack milestones. Give the batch exactly four unique numbered scenes and expected filenames. Once written, that scene plan is binding and must be resumed idempotently until complete.
scenePattern: urban or civic interception at a recognizable real location
historic or architectural cipher operation at a different real location
nature or terrain extraction at a third real location
transport, coast, night, or celebration finale at a fourth real location
planningContract.research: Use established general knowledge only. Never browse the web during automated runs. If uncertain about a landmark, choose a widely known real place or geographically specific environment rather than inventing a factual claim.

scenes.title: Bosphorus Cipher Ferry
scenes.brief: On an empty private ferry deck crossing the Bosphorus at blue hour, Radiance, Ellie, and Alia sprint through a coordinated handoff to capture a floating gold cipher key before it reaches a fictional signal buoy. Merge the recognizable Istanbul strait and layered skyline with prismatic Scorpion Generation light. Use three distinct Turkish-atelier-inspired secular fashion looks in mirror white, matte black, hot red, cobalt, and molten gold, drawing from tulip geometry, contemporary tailoring, and metallic embroidery without flags or official symbols. Low chase camera, wind, spray, full-body action, exactly three women and no other people.

scenes.title: Cappadocia Dawn Balloon Intercept
scenes.brief: At dawn above Cappadocia's recognizable rock valleys, the trio crosses a narrow fictional mirror bridge between formations to redirect a harmless unmanned light capsule descending among distant unbranded balloons. Fashion uses short secure technical-silk separates and action boots in midnight blue, hot red, optical white, and gold with abstract carpet-weave geometry treated as contemporary atelier pattern, never costume. Aerial macro-wide camera, decisive coordinated motion, all three youthful faces readable, no other people.

Dress them in three different sculptural black-white-gold cocktail-and-trouser silhouettes with hot-red lining, bare shoulders where practical, secure opaque construction, and engraved scorpion clasps. Dutch reflection camera across wet marble, ultraviolet projection shadows, clear hands and objective, no guards, crowds, text, damage, or religious imagery.

scenes.brief: Under a huge fictional moon above Pamukkale's white travertine terraces, the trio forms a linked extraction line through shallow water to retrieve an environmental data beacon and restore its blue light to the mineral pools. Use white-gold, cobalt, and scarlet water-safe couture with fully opaque fitted shorts, asymmetric crop architecture, reflective boots or secure sandals, and subtle thorned-rose hardware. High telephoto composition compressing luminous terraces, joyful mission completion, exactly three women, pristine site, no other people.
